record.paper_title: Regularity of maximal operators: recent progress and some open problems
record.original_question: Let Omega be a bounded open convex subset of R^d with Lipschitz boundary and 0 in its interior. For r>0 write Omega(x,r) = {y in R^d: r^{-1}(y-x) is in Omega}, set Omega(x,0)={x}, and let N(x,r) count lattice points in Omega(x,r). For 0 <= beta < d and f: Z^d -> R, define M_{Omega,beta} f(n) = sup_{r>=0} N(0,r)^{beta/d - 1} sum_{m in Omega(0,r)} |f(n+m)|. When 0 <= beta < 1 and q = d/(d-beta), does ||grad M_{Omega,beta} f||_{ell^q(Z^d)} <= C(d,Omega,beta)||grad f||_{ell^1(Z^d)} hold for every discrete function f? More generally, for every 0 <= alpha <= beta and q = d/(d-beta+alpha), does ||grad M_{Omega,beta} f||_{ell^q(Z^d)} <= C ||grad f||_{ell^1(Z^d)}^{1-alpha} ||f||_{ell^1(Z^d)}^{alpha} hold? Do the analogous statements hold for the uncentered Omega-fractional maximal operator?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be a bounded open convex set with Lipschitz boundary containing the origin in its interior. For $x \in \mathbb{R}^d$ and $r > 0$ set
$$\Omega(x,r) = \{y \in \mathbb{R}^d : r^{-1}(y-x) \in \Omega\},\qquad \Omega(x,0) = \{x\},$$
and let $N(x,r) = \#(\Omega(x,r) \cap \mathbb{Z}^d)$ denote the number of lattice points in $\Omega(x,r)$. For $0 \le \beta < d$ and a function $f:\mathbb{Z}^d \to \mathbb{R}$, define the centered discrete $\Omega$-fractional maximal operator
$$M_{\Omega,\beta} f(n) = \sup_{r \ge 0} N(0,r)^{\beta/d - 1} \sum_{m \in \Omega(0,r) \cap \mathbb{Z}^d} |f(n+m)|, \qquad n \in \mathbb{Z}^d,$$
and the corresponding uncentered version $\widetilde M_{\Omega,\beta}$ in which the supremum is taken over all balls $\Omega(x,r)$ containing $n$. Let $\nabla g(n) = (g(n+e_1) - g(n), \dots, g(n+e_d) - g(n))$ denote the discrete gradient.

(a) For $0 \le \beta < 1$ and $q = d/(d-\beta)$, does there exist a constant $C = C(d,\Omega,\beta)$ such that
$$\|\nabla M_{\Omega,\beta} f\|_{\ell^q(\mathbb{Z}^d)} \le C\, \|\nabla f\|_{\ell^1(\mathbb{Z}^d)}$$
for every $f:\mathbb{Z}^d \to \mathbb{R}$?

(b) More generally, for $0 \le \alpha \le \beta$ and $q = d/(d-\beta+\alpha)$, does there exist $C = C(d,\Omega,\alpha,\beta)$ with
$$\|\nabla M_{\Omega,\beta} f\|_{\ell^q(\mathbb{Z}^d)} \le C\, \|\nabla f\|_{\ell^1(\mathbb{Z}^d)}^{1-\alpha}\, \|f\|_{\ell^1(\mathbb{Z}^d)}^{\alpha}?$$

(c) Do the analogous inequalities hold with $M_{\Omega,\beta}$ replaced by the uncentered operator $\widetilde M_{\Omega,\beta}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The continuous analogue (endpoint Sobolev bounds for the fractional Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator) was settled in higher dimensions by Beltran–Madrid and related works around 2020–2022. However, the multidimensional discrete endpoint problem for the centered (and uncentered) Ω-fractional maximal operator on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ with $\ell^1$-gradient data appears to remain open; available results address only special geometries (e.g. $\ell^1$-balls in the multisublinear setting) or the uncentered case in one dimension. No source confirming a full resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Endpoint Sobolev Bounds for Fractional Hardy-Littlewood Maximal Operators
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes endpoint Sobolev bounds in the continuous setting for the fractional Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator, leaving the discrete multidimensional analogue as a separate question.
status_evidence.claim: Continuous endpoint case settled; does not address the discrete multidimensional Ω-fractional setting.

status_evidence.title: Endpoint regularity of discrete multisublinear fractional maximal operators associated with ℓ1-balls
status_evidence.snippet: Studies discrete m-sublinear fractional maximal operators associated with ℓ1-balls; states that certain centered analogues remain open.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the centered discrete multidimensional fractional endpoint problem remains open in general.
